about: Shared FrameUp audio library, used by Video Ads (video-ads.html) and, later, Reels Studio. To add a track: (1) licensed tracks: upload the file to the PRIVATE Supabase bucket frameup-audio (the repo is public, so never commit licensed audio) and set file to storage:frameup-audio/<id>.m4a; free/own tracks may go in assets/audio/<id>.mp3 instead; (2) add an entry to "tracks" below with the fields listed in "fields"; (3) set licence.paid to true ONLY if the licence covers paid ads on every platform (Meta, TikTok, YouTube), and licence.organic to true if it covers organic posts; (4) commit both files. Never add trending commercial songs. Entries with a bad id, path or licence are skipped and the rest still load.

fields.id: lowercase slug, unique, same as the file name (a-z, 0-9, -)
fields.title: track title shown in the picker
fields.licence: { "organic": true|false, "paid": true|false, "note": "licence name and number, e.g. Epidemic Sound Enterprise #1234" }

licence.note: Licensed stock track; owner confirmed paid + organic use (2026-11-19). Stored privately in Supabase, never public.
